name: Document OCR Mindee
description: Document OCR integration with Mindee. Mindee - Accurate and lightning-fast document parsing API.
project_description: Document OCR Mindee is an OCR provider plugin for the Document OCR framework (document_ocr). It registers a single `mindee` processor plugin that uploads a document image or PDF to the Mindee document-parsing SaaS API (api.mindee.net) and maps the returned prediction fields back into the Document OCR mapping so they can be extracted and stored. The processor exposes a chooser for the Mindee product API (expense receipts, invoices, financial documents, passports, proof of address, bank checks, ID cards, license plates and more) and the product version, and reads its API key from a JSON credentials file referenced when the processor is configured. It provides no standalone routes, permissions or config of its own; all setup happens through the Document OCR admin UI at /admin/config/structure/document-ocr.
